title: Normal-base integral lattices in a prescribed completed comparison
statement: Let l be prime and P be a completed-lisse base [def-per-lisse-completed-system-data], so X is Noetherian separated, E/Q_l finite, and l invertible in every residue field. Suppose X is connected and its local rings are integrally closed domains [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Fix any normalized completed-system comparison C. For every locally finite free module L over the continuous rational coefficient sheaf [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data], there exists a locally finite free completed integral module M whose scalar extension along C.coefficientIso.inv followed by the continuous integral-to-field map is isomorphic to L. No representation, monodromy equivalence, integral embedding or descent datum on a chosen cover is asserted. Rank zero is included.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), Lemma 6.8.13 first paragraph, Lemma 7.4.10, pp. 59–61, 71; completion normalization by Lemma 6.8.2(1),(2).

proof.text: Choose a small model of the finite extension, carrying its valuation ring, continuous-function coefficient sheaves, and finite free charts along the coefficient-field isomorphism. Apply [lem-a1-normal-lattice-finite-cover-presentation] on the connected normal Noetherian separated base; residue-field invertibility gives stalk invertibility by the local-ring unit criterion. Transport its actual finite-cover integral lattice and rationalization back to continuous coefficients in the given universe. This is coefficient transport, not a use of rational monodromy essential surjectivity.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-lisse-lattice-finite-etale-descent] after the equivalence with internal abelian-sheaf modules and continuous-coefficient realization. Its image-and-pullback construction descends existence of an integral lattice without requiring a descent datum. Transport back to sheaf modules. The output is locally finite free and rationalizes to L.

Extend the continuous integral lattice along the coefficient isomorphism of the prescribed comparison C of [def-per-lisse-completed-system-data]. Extension and restriction along an isomorphism are inverse, preserve local finite free charts, and associativity of tensor extension identifies rationalization through C.coefficientIso.inv followed by the integral-to-field inclusion with L. This is true for any C; no choice of monodromy functor occurs. Rank zero gives the zero model.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), Lemma 6.8.13 first paragraph, Lemma 7.4.10, pp. 59–61, 71; completion normalization by Lemma 6.8.2(1),(2).

lean.statement:
theorem normal_lisse_completed_lattice (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (P : Base.{u} l) [ConnectedSpace P.X]
    (hnormal : ∀ x : P.X,
      IsDomain (P.X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (P.X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (C : Comparison l P) (L : SfRationalModules l P.E P.X)
    (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFree) :
    ∃ M : Integral l P,
      Nonempty ((completedAdicChange P.X
        (C.coefficientIso.inv ≫ lisseIntegerToFieldSized l P.E P.X)).obj M.obj ≅ L)
